nativeSummary: Photo shows three schooners. The outboard schooner is Stranger. (The name is on her stern.) Built in Essex, MA, in 1883 by Moses Adams. She fished out of Gloucester, but like many of the Gloucester fleet often offloaded in Boston.  (C. Seavey, 2026)
